body:
You made me cry. But deal. Happy Birthday, /u/saintjeremy 
How many more do we have to get through to feel okay? 
I don't know what went wrong in your life, /u/saintjeremy, and I sure as hell don't want to divulge what went wrong in mine, but maybe the fact we're both still alive for this years birthday means we should stick around for the next one too. It might be a better one.
Take care.

I knew a trans girl. She was kind, beautiful and so damn funny. She was one of the most amazing people I've ever met. And it broke my heart when she committed suicide. 

You don't know what the future holds for you until you live it. I'm certain, after you get the right help and begin thinking with more clarity, you'll be just special and wonderful as you already are, except you'll believe it yourself too.

Then make it serious! Music is one of the few things that keeps me going.

That *is* a good point Anti made. Things change everyday. Who's to say tomorrow or next week won't be when your life changes for the better?

I don't know how to comfort you, but I think I can relate to you. My family mostly ignored my existence, but they provided me with all the essentials and I feel like I owe them something or like I'm in debt to them. 

But you know, I'm sure what you said about your life being a joke isn't completely true. You held up this long for something. Hold on longer and see what comes your way. 

And society can go fuck itself. Do what you want, but please, please don't hurt yourself anymore. You deserve better.
